notes: 02: extractor collects title/description/favicon only; no preview image (og:image) is fetched or stored. 06: duplicate url is blocked with a 409 and error message 'This destination is already saved' (server returns existingBookmarkId), but the client never guides/navigates the user to edit the existing bookmark. 11: tag filtering exists at API/search level (tag param, #tag search) but tags on cards are non-interactive spans and there is no select-a-tag UI affordance. 20: no multi-select UI and no bulk endpoint; only per-item PATCH/DELETE. 21: no bulk-over-filter capability. 22: list is always ORDER BY created_at DESC; no sort key param in listQuerySchema or UI. 23: notes textarea exists (write), but notes are never rendered/displayed anywhere and no markdown rendering library or logic is present. 24/25: no snapshot storage, no PDF handling, no Internet Archive integration. 26/27/28: no archived flag in schema, service, or UI; no archive-vs-delete distinction and no archived list. 29: no bundle entity, storage, or saved-filter feature. 30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user settings entity or display-preference controls.
